pages.text: $(bold)Dip Net$()$(br)Hold it in your main or off hand and right-click a fish to scoop it into the net (up to 3). A caught fish goes into a nearby $(bold)Fish Keeper$() first and only flies over when there is none. Right-click a $(bold)Fish Keeper$() to pour the net in, or right-click a block to release one.
$(bold)Living Fish$()$(br)This mods aquatic catch are live entities - they can be caught, netted, kept and displayed.
